pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment (TP) involving placing the food waste in an oven at various temperatures (60 °C, 80 °C, 100 °C, 120 °C, and 140 °C) for different durations (1 h for 60 and 80 °C, and 30 min for 100, 120, and 140 °C).

Biological pre-hydrolysis (BPH) carried out in glass vessels at temperatures (37 °C, 55 °C) with a 10:1 (w/w) ratio of food waste to inoculum, involving a temperature cycle of 37 °C for 20 h followed by 55 °C for 20 h, and then 55 °C for 20 h followed by 37 °C for 20 h.
